verdict.rationale: The open-source Ramp CLI is built for unattended use. It offers `--agent` JSON output (the default when piped) and `--no-input` to disable prompts for CI. Standalone agents can log in without a browser by exchanging OAuth client credentials (RAMP_CLIENT_ID/SECRET), and RAMP_PROFILE pins an identity for automation. These are backed by OAuth client-credentials server-to-server access, a sandbox environment that keeps CI runs off real money, and a live 174-path OpenAPI schema. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI actually running headlessly in a CI pipeline (probes verify only the MCP and OpenAPI endpoints).
